reviews.text:
I have been with Pickles since the beginning, and could not fault them in any way. They were there when my Sam had to leave and are still there providing outstanding service to not only my Dave but the whole community.
Thank you all in the Pickles family.
Peter woodburn.💙

Richard and his team are genuinely some of the kindest, most compassionate people I have ever come across. If it wasn’t for them, my beautiful boy Pimms simply wouldn’t have had the extra time we were so lucky to have together.
Pimms was diagnosed with an extremely aggressive form of bone cancer, and one of the hardest decisions we ever had to make was having one of his rear legs amputated. I will forever be grateful to our incredible vet Alice, who performed his amputation and then continued to look after Pimms throughout his entire journey.
Alice was absolutely amazing with Pimms. She treated him with so much kindness, patience and compassion, and gave him the very best care every step of the way. Knowing that he was looked after by someone who cared so deeply about him meant more to me than I could ever put into words. Pimms then continued going back to Pickles every three weeks for chemotherapy, and despite everything he had been through, he would still get ridiculously excited to see everyone and run straight up to the door!
The whole Pickles team did absolutely everything they could to support us as a family and give Pimms the best possible quality of life. But Alice deserves a special mention for being there for him from such a devastating diagnosis, through his amputation and chemotherapy, and ultimately being there for him until the very end.
Sadly, my beautiful boy has now passed away, but I will always be eternally grateful to Alice, Rory, Richard and the entire Pickles team for everything they did for him. We were so incredibly lucky to have found them.
They weren’t just caring for Pimms, they genuinely cared about him, loved him and supported us through one of the hardest journeys I had ever had to face. Myself and Pimms are eternally grateful to you all ❤️

Poppy my beloved Cat was looked after so well by the team. I would recomend Pickles to anyone who wants to feel really looked after. Excellent service and thank you to the whole team from the initial call to post check ups. Thank you :)

Horrible vet ! I have no idea how this vet got 5 star everyone is extremely amateurs they have no idea about dogs health. I had the worst experience of my life , my dog almost got blind. I wont recommend this vet to anyone at all!
Dr Rory was brilliant with my dog Ava today, really looked after her and ensured she was right as rain. Thank you

Pickles is a fabulous vet that is incredibly pet-forward. They are all such great professionals, particularly Charlotte, Em, Alice and Zoe. I'd recommend this vet to anyone, and I'm happy to travel the width of London to give my pet the best care

Couldn’t recommend Pickles enough! Although our introduction to them was not on the most uplifting case, with our Kitty unfortunately being in the final stage of CKD, the team at Pickles advised thoroughly and fought incredible hard to nurse Kitty back to health; unfortunately it was Kittys time but they provided her with comfort and plenty of attention in her last few days. The whole team was up to date with Kittys status and genuinely invested in her health which is incredibly reassuring and made the experience so much more personable for both myself and I’m sure Kitty!

We received updates and photos of Kitty throughout her hospitalisation and we knew she was in good experienced hands! Furthermore, after Kitty’s passing, which was out of hours therefore at a different practice, we informed Pickles of the news, and a few days later received a hand written card from Alice and the team; thank you so much to everyone at Pickles, but a shout out to Alice who made an extremely difficult period more palatable, for both me and Kitty!

If you are looking for a vet, I would highly recommend Pickles - honestly the best service I’ve had and how vets should be! I’m sure we’ll be back to see Alice and the team sometime soon!

We moved our 7yr old Scottish fold cat to Pickles in the autumn of last year.
We had previously been at Village Vet but felt that after their sale to Linnaeus Group and COVID, the service had really decreased and our trust had been broken with the team there.
Pickles (and Rory) were fantastic, Khan has had a surgery to his ears with a visiting specialist, with some complications, since joining and the whole team were wonderfully supportive throughout, incredibly kind and understanding.
The membership model really works for us, as Khan is getting older, it's nice to feel check ups aren't budgetary punitive. Serina has been really helpful lately with some allergy treatments but it's clear the whole team are animal lovers.
The vets itself is calming, clean, friendly and really responsive to messages so has been a great decision to move overall.
We couldn't be happier and Khan gives them a 5-paw review!
Excellent Vet in Fulham. Good from beginning to end. Plus they looked after our dog Murphy (Irish Terrier). I would highly recommend them
What a great team very happy 😊 …
Not like any other vetinary practice I have been to. Friendly and reassuring staff in a lovely light relaxing atmosphere.

Truly cannot recommend Pickles more. Ziggy is a very anxious boy, and the entire team are nothing less than incredible with him. They’re patient, put him and his needs first & are so accommodating and understanding. Not only is life stressful for Ziggy at times, it can be for me too & the team are so so kind to us both. Dr Emily & Siobhan have been phenomenal and I cannot sing their praise enough. Thank you - you are all the best!
Pickles is an excellent practice run professionally and with a lot of kindness and is a great asset to our local community

I have a really reactive dog and it is an absolute pleasure visiting Pickles. The lay out of the waiting room is so well thought out. The front of office staff couldn’t be more welcoming and the vets are just fabulous. I highly recommend them. Independent vets all the way I say!

I feel so lucky to have this vet after a bad experience at a big chain nearby. The whole team is great, from Stacey to Emily, who carried out successful surgery on my dog's eye with professionalism but also warmth.

Highly recommend.
Everyone very helpful and friendly
Absolutely amazing team, from the level of care to how friendly all the staff are. We love them! Also super clean inside too, which is not the case with a lot of vet practices
It is a very friendly, nice and happy place!

I’m a vet nurse myself, and working in a practice without dentistry. When my little man needed his teeth sorted, I looked to Rory and the team. The whole experience was seamless, the care was exceptional and my cat’s wellbeing was top priority. I was kept in the loop all day and involved in decision making. Thank you to the whole Pickles team
First visit for the Red the cat, as always all the staff at Pickles very friendly and welcoming, really helped Red to feel relaxed while he had his vaccinations. Thank you.

Absolutely amazing place to go to for pet care .. staff is friendly , helpful and kind , premises are so clean and hygienic , pet care is marvellous! Would highly recommend thsi practice to everyone 😍❤️ …

Amazing vets - always friendly, knowledgeable, accommodating, and experienced. The callback service means you don’t have to wait ages on hold on the phone for an appointment, and they can always fit us in if we need an unexpected last minute appointment.

My dog has intense vet anxiety - Pickles offers ‘cuddle consults’ where we can come in and just interact with a member of staff in a friendly way, so they play with Gigi and give her cuddles and love as part of a programme to try and get her comfortable with the vet. This is all included in our membership too!

Just a wonderful experience, would highly recommend

I brought Solar here after she was hit by a bike on our walk. Solar wasn’t registered but they were very friendly, booked us in and sorted registering her there and then. No damage was done to Solar just bruising but at the time of the incident I thought it was a lot worse, so the staff were happy to see Solar as soon as they could to check she was OK! The staff here are very lovely and I will keep my registration even though it was initially just for an emergency appointment. Thank you! 🧡

I have been with pickles for a couple of years now, on the recommendation of a friend. They have always been so very kind and gentle. They always explain things clearly and answer any questions I have. When my older dog was at the end of his life, we were treated with such tenderness and the team were so supportive. I couldn't recommend them highly enough.

Pickles is a wonderful vets. They have a marvellous subscription service where you pay once a year a small fee and you can have as many consultations as needed. They are super friendly yet very professional. I have never experienced such a wonderful vets in my life. I wouldn’t take my cats anywhere other than Pickles
I cannot recommend Pickles highly enough. The ability to have a consultation is very welcome, removing any anxiety the owner may have about fees etc. Had a great recent experience

I took my cat Cali in today for his yearly checkup and booster, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Dr. Rory Cowlam — who looked after him — was incredibly sweet, kind, and gentle … exactly what Cali needed, as he was very nervous. He didn’t even flinch when he received his booster shot, which says a lot about how calm and reassuring Dr. Rory was.

He was also extremely knowledgeable and took the time to recommend helpful products for my cat’s dental care, then promptly followed up by email just as he’d promised. The whole process — from booking to appointment — was quick and easy. No long three-week waits just to be seen, which is such a relief.

Pickles Vets truly offer a wonderful service. I especially appreciate their yearly membership, which includes boosters and all standard services (with medications being the only extra cost). It gives me real peace of mind.

Highly recommend!
Always a warm welcome from Stacey and everyone is so nice and it makes Dollys visit stress free she’s so happy to see everyone. I have recommended Pickles to other dog owners. They’re great.

The team at Pickles are amazing especially Alice who has seen both My Dogs a few times and always treats them well & goes above and beyond to make sure We have everything dealt with before We leave I highly recommend this vets as every experience going there has been delightful. Both My Dogs have had operations there & I’ve felt at ease both times 🤩🤩

Pickles vets have been absolutely brilliant with our black Labradors. The eldest lived to the ripe old age of 16 and a half and always had the best care from the Pickles team. Now our younger 4 year old, who suffered from a nasty ear infection, which they cleared up quickly and the after care was excellent - again thank you to the Pickles team - just the best vets! Highly recommend 🤩
Courteous staff and always helpful
Most amazing vet you will visit. Kind caring and always super helpful staff.
I am new to this independent vet but Pickles came highly recommended from several friends and I can quite see why.
Fantastic vet! Went out of their way to deal with an emergency with my cat and could not have been nicer staff who were extremely efficient, honest and understanding.

10/10 service! From the moment you step in the door, you are warmly welcomed in a very nice and relaxed environment. Had a lovely chat with the vet that took things at our pace, listened to our concerns and advised accordingly. Thank you so much to Stacey and Vet Rory! Pickles are definitely setting a new standard for vet care!
It’s how all vets should be!
Absolutely fantastic very friendly
Our lovely pet Luna was so well looked after on her last day by Rory and the entire team. Huge kindness and consideration for her and us.

This is the best bet I have experienced in my 70+ years. The kindness and caring is unsurpassed. I have read a poor review of this vet and I can only assume it has been written by misinformed business opposition. The surgeons and nurses are not being employed by a chain of ripoff vets. They are truly value for money

Simply put, Pickles are the best Vet we’ve ever had in London. Cannot recommend them highly enough and we’ve been through it all - chronic illness and an operation for our dog, through to handling the passing of our beloved family cat - all done with the utmost care and sympathy. Booking an appointment is easy with the app, and follow ups are quick, prescriptions are hassle free.  Thank you everyone and especially Rory, Emily & Clare, for eveything.
Outstanding care to both pets and nervous owners. This is the best vet practice I've ever used.

Truly the best vet practice we’ve experienced in the UK. The vets are highly knowledgeable and accommodating of Rudy’s needs; very friendly and helpful admin staff. We’ve had two surgeries for tumour removal and dental surgery - all went in best possible way, in both cases Alice was the best doctor we could possibly wish for. The way how the business model is organised with annual subscription means you don’t have to worry about the incremental cost every time you visit a vet, but focus more on the needs of your pet. Would highly recommend!
Great service overall, really happy with the care.

I highly recommend this fab vets. My dog had to have mouth surgery and Pickles gave him the best care ever - made sure he was comfortable throughout and great after care too - he was honestly so well looked after here! Love this vets

Pickles is simply the best veterinary surgery we have ever used. Both of my animals (and one is a cat) are really happy to visit. My dog gets sooo excited when we get near to Pickles in Fulham. Stacey is a wonderful, friendly and efficient person on Reception. Clare is a caring and fantastic nurse. All of the vets support staff are just so lovely, and the atmosphere in Pickles is relaxed but ultra efficient. Dr Alice FR has done just brilliant surgery and medical assessments on both of my animals - cannot recommend this surgery highly enough.
Great experience, my cat loves this clinic.

Free consultations with very expensive prescriptions. Be mindful this is a basic vet care and if your pet needs any extra care they won’t be able to provide,  therefore the cost will be extremely expensive. Also check their time table as when closed and after hours their partners (Wolve Vets in Wandsworth Road) are truly terrifying! I had a horrible experience with them, the only cared about money, were so rude and so very expensive!!! Unfortunately Pickles didn’t want to know either…. They are a welcoming friendly team till something goes wrong! Then they don’t want to know! You really are better off with Google Vets 😆 . In another note, Check out Celia Hammond Animal Trust which are doing a fantastic job and they care so much for the welfare of your pets! At affordable prices :)
All members of staff absolutely rock! I ❤️ Pickles and so does my dog Coco
Amazing doctors, care and very friendly.
This is absolutely, undoubtedly, 100% the vet to have. Rory is a genius, and no one loves animals the way he does. You will not find better care anywhere.
Just signed up. Very convenient set up thought the membership and Emily (the Vet we met today at our first visit) was very nice and professional.

It is a lovely experience to visit Pickles. Caring  staff.  Mittens has been very well looked by Rory  for the last 12 months and we will be eternally grateful . Mittens is in remission and we are thrilled with his progress

A refreshing vibe from the corporate, and increasingly faceless and overpriced vet chains.  Membership is a good model.  All staff friendly, clinical staff competent and everybody clearly loves animals.
Went to the vets today for some information the receptionist they were so kind and helpful it was a pleasure meeting them
Pickles vet : very happy with the first visit with my new kitten who was handled very carefully by Alice, and very friendly receptionist in this immaculate and welcoming practice
My second time at Pickles and I am equally impressed….with the warm attentive and professional staff from start to finish….
Simply superb in every way. In my 73 years of owning many animals, I have never found  a vet Anywhere near as communicative and knowledgeable – thoroughly fantastic with animals, and owners alike
A great first experience at Pickles. Very warm and friendly atmosphere. Considerate and kind team.

I would give these people 100 stars if I could...the care and patients are impeccable...i always dealt with Rory, every visit to the practice was always welcoming, the time on your appointment never seemed rushed, and every question I asked, was answered...very professional...these guys have so much respect and empathy towards you and your companion..
My beloved do star sadly passed away on 27/02/2025...aged 17....Rory gave me so much information regards after hours emergency vet...Rory was very accommodating , understanding the devastating outcome which lay ahead, I personally thank you so much for that...
STAR will be forever in my heart,  but he passed very peacefully, in no pain, with family surrounding him...
The guys at pickles practice on fulham road SW6 sent me flowers a few days later...  which was an amazing comfort, and I was so grateful for that, at such a very sad time in our life's.....

Thank you for reading
Call them , and register your beloved companion,  these guys are so amazing 👏 it will forever stay with me the kindness, I recieved.
X
Very welcoming staff and veterinarian Emily with helpful advice and treatment given without any issues. Our dog is at ease here and throughout a very positive experience. Thank you to all the team!
Best vet we’ve ever used and love their pricing approach. Paying for the year means we don’t worry before taking our dog in as we have already paid. Lovely staff and nice clean, stylish clinic.

I was a Pickles client for two years and I would recommend anyone with a pet to choose them as their vets. Starting for the reason of Pickles creation - a loving tribute to Richard’s (Pickles founder) dog - all the way to the stunning facilities but, more importantly, a friendly and professional staff.

I have to particularly highlight Dr. Claudia Dos Santos and Dr. Rory Cowlam who were the vets that mainly treated us. They were incredible throughout and I particularly owe Rory the extra year and a bit that I shared with my Bruno.

When the time comes for us to have another pet, I wouldn’t think twice to register with Pickles.

Edit: although Dr Rory is great at his craft, I have to say I’ve been quite disappointed at the lack of empathy with Bruno’s passing. Although he was on holiday when it happened, we did have a follow up scheduled with him upon his return + he was well aware of his condition before leaving. Three weeks in, and not even an email.

I do have to say the practice sent a card and flowers, which was a nice touch. More the reason to wonder the lack of care on Dr Cowlam’s part.
Our miniature dachshund Wispa always feels very calm and safe at pickles. We have had the pleasure of meeting nearly all of the vets and nurse and they are all very helpful and experienced.
Love this vet! My cat is very calm here!
Another great experience at Pickles. They are so thorough in their approach and treat our dog with true & genuine care. Can’t recommend enough

Pickles is the best membership a cat or dog owner can ever have! First visit today with my kitty Pixie who can be a feline diva but was SO totally chilled throughout her whole examination. Kelly was wonderful both with Pixie and myself. Thorough, informative, supportive, friendly and highly professional. Pixie required a needle inserted to a mass on her neck. Expecting diva cat action I was ready with "cat mum" hold down - but she didn't even flinch! This is the exceptional professionalism and care of a true veterinary star. Kelly and the Pickles team, Pixie and I are so grateful for all your care and attention. Highly recommend to all cat and dog 'parents' in Fulham and surrounding areas. Absolutely top class vets.

Fantastic Vets and practice! Both of our dogs registered here and the staff have been wonderful, truly, every time. Every member of staff in every role here routinely go above and beyond for the two boys and my partner and I as owners. This is what great veterinary practice looks like!
Membership program is great value, very convenient with lots of availability and vets and front desk staff are wonderful.
I am so glad we found Pickles. Everyone is so nice. Stacey on the front desk is always so happy and the vets are all so caring. Always a pleasure to visit and see the same face!
I’ve been taking my pet here for the past 18 months and it’s exceptional with service and care for my archie

Beware: Pickles Puts Profit Before Pet Care

Pickles Veterinary Clinic markets itself as a friendly, caring, "new kind of vet." However, behind the colourful front lies a practice more concerned with cutting costs than providing proper care for the animals they're meant to look after.

This morning, I took my male kitten in for neutering, and what followed was nothing short of alarming. During the initial check-up, the nurse pulled out an outdated rectal thermometer. I requested a chip-reading thermometer – a modern, stress-free option I’ve seen at other vets over the years. She informed me that their technical director, Rory, had decided not to buy them. It seems that saving a few pounds is more important to Pickles than the comfort and care of their patients.

When I asked to speak to Rory, I was told he was "busy." She proceeded to insert the rectal thermometer into my kitten causing him to squirm and meow in pain until I pulled him away. Moments later, I found him in the next room, doing absolutely nothing. His attitude was shockingly rude and dismissive. When I raised the issue about the thermometer, he outright denied it, despite his nurse confirming it was his decision not to invest in the proper equipment. She then denied saying this, and he said he can trust either her or me, implying quite clearly I was lying, even though I had no motivation to do so. Instead of addressing my concerns, Rory smirked condescendingly at me and implied that I was being unreasonable for wanting better treatment for my pet.

At this point, I lost all trust in this practice. Not only are they using outdated, uncomfortable methods, but it's clear they prioritise saving money over the welfare of the animals in their care. I decided to leave, as I could not risk my kitten’s health with a vet more focused on their budget than on providing quality care.

Yes, Pickles may be cheap, but you truly get what you pay for – and that’s far from good enough. If you care about your pet’s well-being, I strongly recommend you go elsewhere.

Such a great and friendly vet. We took our black lab there for a second opinion on his ear infection and we are definitely switching to Pickles. All the crew was amazing and made R feel at ease despite his vet fear. Quote, treatment plant and rapid service - totally recommend 🐕 Loved the welcome tote back with the dog toys and treat! …
The staff are so lovely, and I love it in there. If you have any free time. Please go in there, they will look after your animals
